description:
research-review F3 on the campaign freeze: `backend-selection-v1.md` claims all
124 selection-cohort configurations pass correctness rules at their nominated
cells, but the committed equivalence evidence
(`dev/active/b8206228-permanent-statistics/e31b1918-equiv-host-full.csv` and the
shared-equivalence receipt it extends) covers only orders {8,12,16,20,24,28}
per field plus the exact-anchor cell (3,4). Campaign cells off that grid have
no cell-applicable equivalence row. The owner selected: produce the evidence.

The harness is `dev/research/permanent-sampling-feas` (`equivalence`
subcommand). Its order table stops at the timed grid orders, so it must be
extended to run every exact campaign cell: q=3 n=4..28, q=5 n=4..24,
q=7 n=4..20 (63 cells), evaluating at each cell the configurations
`backend-selection-v1.md` nominates there (both selection arms), against the
reference implementation on shared inputs. The per-cell matrix-count budget
derivation from commit `de5f7414` (halving from a per-order ceiling, flooring
at 2, against summed committed probe costs) extends to the new orders.

## Success criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed equivalence CSV covers every campaign cell with at
  least one row per nominated configuration at that exact (q,n), each row
  comparing per-matrix permanent values against the reference on shared inputs
  with zero mismatches, or recording the mismatch.
- [hard] REQ-02: The run's provenance records source revision, executable
  SHA-256, toolchain, RNG implementation and version, seed root, and stream
  identity for the drawn matrices.
- [hard] REQ-03: An addendum document cites the receipt and states the closure
  of the backend-selection coverage claim, recording the prior evidence scope
  as the contradiction falsification-preserved requires; `backend-selection-v1.md`
  itself is not modified.
- [hard] REQ-04: The GPU-dependent rows run inside the owner's safe window
  (from 02:00 local); no campaign draw occurs (equivalence uses non-campaign
  stream purposes only).
title: Cell-exhaustive backend equivalence receipt for the 124 nominated selection configurations
